I’m 64 this year, been farming since I was 19. My father taught me, and I’ve seen good years and bad years. I’ve got 13.5 mu total — about 7 mu in cotton and 6.5 mu in wheat-maize double cropping. It’s just me and the wife at home now, so I have to watch both the labor and the cash. We need money for medicine and daily expenses, so I can’t spend everything on the fields. The extension fellow gives advice, but after 45 years I know my own land.

The wheat went in last October, so it’s already in the ground. Winter was a bit dry, but the stand looks okay. I’ll give it the first irrigation after Qingming if it doesn’t rain — that’s the green-up water. I put down compound fertilizer at planting, and I’ll topdress about 10 kg of urea per mu at jointing. The extension agent says 15 kg N per mu for wheat, but 12 kg total has been enough for me. I irrigate three times: green-up, jointing, and grain filling. Each time costs me pumping fees, so I don’t waste water. I sprayed herbicide in early spring, and I’ll watch for disease — maybe one fungicide if it looks bad. Last year I got about 420 kg per mu, hoping for the same. The combine will harvest in early June.

For cotton, I’m planting around April 20th on the 7 mu. I buy Bt hybrid seed from the county store — about 45 yuan per mu. I plowed this field last fall, and I’ll harrow it before planting. I put compound fertilizer in the furrow at planting, about 50 kg per mu, and I’ll topdress urea at flowering — maybe 10 kg per mu. Total N is about 13 kg per mu. The soil here is decent, not great. Cotton needs water at planting, flowering, and boll stage — three times total. I’ll spray herbicide once before emergence, and insecticide 3-4 times for bollworm and aphids. Cotton is labor-heavy: thinning, pruning, picking. The wife and I do most of it, but I’ll hire a few days of help for the autumn picking. I expect around 280 kg of seed cotton per mu if the weather cooperates.

Maize goes in right after wheat harvest in early June — sometimes I only have 3-4 days. I hire a combine for the wheat, then rotary till and plant maize immediately. I use hybrid seed, about 40 yuan per mu. One base fertilizer application at planting, then urea at the big trumpet stage. N total about 13 kg per mu. Two irrigations: one at tasseling, one at grain filling. Maize is easier — one herbicide spray and that’s mostly it. I expect about 480 kg per mu.

Why these numbers? Because they worked last year, more or less. I thought about putting more fertilizer on the cotton, but fertilizer prices went up and my pension is small. Better to be a bit conservative than to run out of cash. The neighbor with 20 mu puts more inputs, but he has more land and his son sends money from Tianjin. I don’t have that. So I stick with what I know.
